content.value_statement: Choosing a bidding model without reliable history can stall delivery or waste spend. This skill selects a strategy, derives an initial target, and plans learning.
actual_capabilities: Selects tCPA, tROAS, max-conversions, max-conversion-value, or manual CPC using campaign goals and conversion volume.
Derives initial tCPA or tROAS targets from trailing account performance.
Groups compatible campaigns into bid portfolios by goal, target, and funnel stage.
Plans learning-phase entry, review timing, and conditions that may reset learning.
Labels metrics as measured, user-provided, estimated, or missing.
limitations: Requires campaign goals, performance history, and conversion volume for evidence-based target selection.
Uses estimated thresholds that may differ from current advertising platform behavior.
Does not allocate budgets, monitor live pacing, or audit the full advertising account.
Does not change live campaigns or retrieve platform data without a separate connector.

use_cases.title: Choose a launch strategy
use_cases.description: Select a bidding model and starting target for a new or restructured campaign.

use_cases.title: Set a revenue target
use_cases.description: Translate ecommerce ROAS history into an achievable initial tROAS and learning plan.

use_cases.title: Design bid portfolios
use_cases.description: Group client campaigns with compatible economics while separating conflicting goals and funnel stages.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a bid strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Choose a bid strategy for [campaign]. The goal is [goal]. Recent results are [CPA or ROAS] from [conversion count] conversions in 30 days.
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin with one campaign and known performance history.

prompt_templates.title: Set an initial target
prompt_templates.prompt: Set an initial tCPA or tROAS target for [campaign] using this history: [metrics]. Show the calculation and label each input source.
prompt_templates.scenario: Derive a practical target from recent account results.

prompt_templates.title: Group a campaign portfolio
prompt_templates.prompt: Group these campaigns into bid portfolios: [campaign data]. Separate incompatible goals or funnel stages. Explain each grouping and identify missing inputs.
prompt_templates.scenario: Plan shared bidding across several campaigns.

prompt_templates.title: Plan advanced learning entry
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a learning-phase entry plan for [campaign set] using [strategy, target, budget, history]. Estimate exit conditions, define a stable window, and flag reset risks.
prompt_templates.scenario: Coordinate strategy, targets, portfolios, and learning controls.

output_examples.input: A lead campaign has a $42 trailing CPA and 90 conversions during the last 30 days.
output: Recommendation: tCPA because conversion volume exceeds the estimated eligibility threshold.
Starting target: $44, based on the user-provided $42 CPA with modest initial headroom.
Learning plan: hold target and budget stable through the first review window.

output_examples.input: An ecommerce campaign has 60 monthly conversions, value tracking, and a trailing 3.8x ROAS.
output: Recommendation: tROAS because the campaign has sufficient conversion volume and revenue data.
Starting target: 3.6x to 3.8x, based on achievable trailing performance.
Review plan: increase the target only after learning stabilizes.

output_examples.input: Four campaigns include two direct-response lead campaigns, one ecommerce campaign, and one prospecting campaign.
output: Portfolio one: group the lead campaigns when their CPA targets are comparable.
Portfolio two: keep the ecommerce campaign separate because it optimizes revenue.
Portfolio three: keep prospecting separate because its funnel stage and signal differ.

best_practices: Provide trailing CPA or ROAS, conversion count, campaign goal, and funnel stage.
Use achieved account performance as the starting point for target calculations.
Keep targets and budgets stable during the defined learning window.
anti_patterns: Do not set tCPA or tROAS without adequate conversion history.
Do not combine campaigns with conflicting goals, economics, or funnel stages.
Do not make large target or budget changes during learning without reviewing reset risk.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the campaign goal, trailing CPA or ROAS, conversion count, funnel stage, current strategy, and any hard bidding constraints.

faq.question: Can the skill work without conversion history?
faq.answer: It can suggest max-conversions or manual CPC, but it will not invent a tCPA or tROAS target.

faq.question: Does the skill change live campaign settings?
faq.answer: No. It produces a recommendation and plan for review.

faq.question: Can it group campaigns into one portfolio?
faq.answer: Yes. It groups campaigns only when their goals, targets, and funnel stages are compatible.

faq.question: Are the learning thresholds guaranteed?
faq.answer: No. They are estimated rules of thumb and should be checked against current platform guidance and account results.

faq.question: Does it allocate campaign budgets?
faq.answer: No. It uses budget context for learning risk but leaves budget allocation and live pacing to other workflows.
